This '''unnamed Shadow Guard''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Emperor's Shadow Guard]]. He was stationed aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|First Death Star]]. He was killed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] former apprentice [[Galen Marek]] when he [[Battle on Death Star I|infiltrated]] the battle station to rescue the Rebel leaders and dueled the guard.

==Biography==
At some point, he became a member of the [[Emperor's Shadow Guard]], an elite subdivision of the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guard]]. In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], he was stationed aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]] with orders from [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. When [[Galen Marek]], the former secret apprentice of Darth Vader, [[Battle on Death Star I|stormed the battle station]] to rescue the captured Rebel leaders, he proceeded to mow down the garrison of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], [[Imperial Heavy Trooper/Legends|Imperial heavy troopers]], [[Jumptrooper/Legends|Imperial jumptroopers]], and [[Imperial medic/Legends|Imperial medics]]. Upon reaching the entrance to the observation dome, the Shadow Guard personally confronted the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] alongside four Royal Guardsmen, also sealing the door to the throne room. The two engaged in a duel. Marek won, and proceeded to snap his neck.

==Powers and abilities==
As a Shadow Guard, he was proficient with a [[Lightsaber pike/Legends|lightsaber pike]], using it in the duel. The guardsmen also was able to use the Force to some extent, producing purple [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] and able to [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Choke|Force choke]]. In the end, his skills were no match for that of Marek's.
